title: As Trump Weighs Sale of Advanced A.I. Chips to China, Critics Sound Alarm
summary: The president signaled he would discuss the sale of Nvidia’s Blackwell chips in a summit on Thursday, a move U.S. officials warned would be a “massive” national security mistake.

title: SSE Is Said to Explore Funding Options Including Share Sale
summary: SSE Plc is exploring funding options, including a share sale that could raise billions of pounds, as the utility seeks capital to meet a grid spending boost, according to people familiar with the matter.
